name: Heist.exe
detailed_description:
Infiltrate the depths of cyberspace on a life-or-death mission to reclaim stolen valuables. Stealth around robotic guards, manipulate the surrounding environment, and retrieve your client's prized possession to ultimately escape the network. But once you snag it, the sinister NETBots will shotgun the self-destruction of their own network—all in an attempt to permanently wipe you from existence! Get in, get out, and take back what's NOT rightfully theirs.  

Features

  • Play as Agent Tehsi, a professional spy who's fast on her feet and adept with machinery! You can activate terminals to open and close walls or create walkways to new heights, which also keep you safe from the sights of guards.

  • Find a possession at the end of the level, then traverse back through it in a different way! Use the very item you've retrieved by putting it on buttons that also open walls or shrink blocks.

  • Avoid the robotic guards and sentries surveying the area. They'll stop at nothing to capture you and keep the possession from your grasp!

  • Be prepared to escape the network shutdown! After reclaiming the possession, an escape sequence triggers and demands that you escape before time's up. What's more, certain terminals deactivate, making escape even harder!

  • Each room has its own camera angle(s), allowing for simple yet effective observation of each challenge.

  • Enjoy two full levels of accessible and exciting gameplay! At least one additional level will be released with the full version of the game.

short_description: A sci-fi stealth game in which you must infiltrate digital facilities, steal back the possessions within, and escape without being seen. These "networks" contain switches that can alter your path or stop guards from seeing you. Activate them on your own or with the stolen possession!
